title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on this week's Israeli sports headlines — from Zagreb gymnastics to a Tbilisi basketball squad list.

questions.question: Ahead of Israel's basketball warm-up against Georgia in Tbilisi, which two NBA players were not released by their clubs for the national team window?
questions.explanation: Ynet reported that NBA players Deni Avdija and Ben Saraf were not released by their clubs for the window that included the Georgia friendly.

questions.question: What score did Artem Dolgopyat post to win his third European floor exercise title in Zagreb?
questions.explanation: Dolgopyat won gold in the floor final at the European Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Zagreb on 21 August 2026 with a score of 14.466.

questions.question: Manor Solomon scored on his full West Ham debut in a 2-2 draw against which club?
questions.explanation: Solomon, who joined West Ham from Tottenham on 10 August 2026, scored on his full debut in a 2-2 draw at Burnley on 16 August 2026.

questions.question: Who scored Lugano's penalty winner in the 54th minute against Maccabi Tel Aviv in their Conference League play-off first leg?
questions.explanation: Anto Grgic scored a penalty winner in the 54th minute as Lugano beat Maccabi Tel Aviv 2-1 in Switzerland on 20 August 2026.

questions.question: In Israel's historic 2-1 win over host South Korea at the 2017 World Baseball Classic, whose infield single drove in the winning run in the tenth inning?
questions.explanation: Scott Burcham's infield single in the tenth inning drove in pinch-runner Mike Meyers to seal Israel's win over South Korea on 6 March 2017.
